app.Q3N2.action.cmVhZA.option.ZmllbGRz.d.source:
A hash describing the CSV fields on input. Keys are field names as given by the `header_names` or `headers` options (if neither is used, field names are numbers starting with `0`). Values are [field types](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) or a hash with the following keys:
- `type`: a [field type string](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`: for `date` types, a [date format](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting); for `int`, `float`, or `number` types, a number format string: *<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]] (e.g. `".,3"` = `.` thousands, `,` decimal, 3 decimal places)
- `timezone`: for `date` types only; passed to [TimeZone::constructor()](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/class_qore_1_1_time_zone.html#ab77972801cee2c9d116a9631dfd631d9) to parse dates (overrides any default time zone; use when different columns have different time zones)

**Note**: setting this value also sets `headers` if not set automatically with `header_names`. If no field type is given, the default is `*string`. Invalid field names in this option are ignored.
app.Q3N2.action.cmVhZA.option.ZmllbGRz.d.message:
Hash popisujúci polia CSV na vstupe. Kľúče sú názvy polí zadané možnosťami `header_names` alebo `headers` (ak nie je použitá žiadna z nich, názvy polí sú čísla začínajúce od `0`). Hodnoty sú [field types](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) alebo hash s nasledujúcimi kľúčmi:
- `type`: [field type string](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`: pre typy `date`, [date format](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting); pre typy `int`, `float` alebo `number`, reťazec formátu čísla: *<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]] (napr. `".,3"` = `.` tisíce, `,` desatinné, 3 desatinné miesta)
- `timezone`: len pre typy `date`; odovzdané do [TimeZone::constructor()](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/class_qore_1_1_time_zone.html#ab77972801cee2c9d116a9631dfd631d9) na parsovanie dátumov (prepíše akékoľvek predvolené časové pásmo; použite, keď rôzne stĺpce majú rôzne časové pásma)

**Poznámka**: nastavenie tejto hodnoty tiež nastaví `headers`, ak nie je nastavené automaticky s `header_names`. Ak nie je zadaný žiadny typ poľa, predvolená hodnota je `*string`. Neplatné názvy polí v tejto možnosti sa ignorujú.

app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.ZmllbGRz..source:
A hash describing the CSV fields to output. Keys are field names, values are [field types](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) or a hash with the following keys:
- `type`: a [field type string](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`: for `date` types, a [date format](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting); for `int`, `float`, or `number` types, a number format string: *<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]] (e.g. `".,3"` = `.` thousands, `,` decimal, 3 decimal places)
app.Q3N2.action.d3JpdGU.option.ZmllbGRz..message:
Hash popisujúci polia CSV na výstup. Kľúče sú názvy polí, hodnoty sú [field types](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types) alebo hash s nasledujúcimi kľúčmi:
- `type`: [field type string](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/modules/CsvUtil/html/class_csv_util_1_1_abstract_csv_iterator.html#abstractcsviterator_option_field_types)
- `format`: pre typy `date`, [date format](https://qoretechnologies.com/manual/qorus/current/qore/lang/html/group__date__and__time__functions.html#date_formatting); pre typy `int`, `float` alebo `number`, reťazec formátu čísla: *<thousands_separator>*[*<decimal_separator>*[*<decimals>*]] (napr. `".,3"` = `.` tisíce, `,` desatinné, 3 desatinné miesta)
